main_text.p: Christus denunciabatur, secundum notas quidē apte, cum tamē substantia eorū longe repugnabat. Et cur in ijs tum sacramentis, tantopere quaerimus substantię conuenientia, cum ea haud multū ad rē attineat? Neque enim mysterium in materia ipsa latet, sed multo magis in occultioribus quibusdam rerū notis, quibus panis et corpus Christi, uinū & sanguis, sibi mutua analogia respondentinuicem. Quā analogiam dum secū consideret Christiana mēs, hinc magnā fidei cōfirmatione, simul et cōscientię consolatione cōsequi necesse est, præsertim ijs qui afflicto sunt spiritu & laborant onerati. Quid enim huiusmodi pectori dulcius aut plausibilius esse potest, cē ubi nō creditur solum, sed etiam uidet quasi ante oculos expressum, gratis condonari peccata omnia, longam inediam, ceu in communio expleri, famem in saturitatem verti, consilescere omnes moresVisus ac fidei
Visus ac fidei nis cœnæ dominicæ

page.notes: Marginal notes at right: "Visus ac fidei nis cœnæ" and "dominicæ". The right-margin note reads "Visus ac fi-/nis cœnæ/dominicæ" and is set in italic. Several words near the column foot are faint and show-through from the reverse side is present; words such as "consilescere" and "mores" are uncertain.
